status: red-finding; behavior deliberately UNCHANGED in C2
what: nxinput_rewrite_portmaster_handheld_mapping (src/nxinput.c) rewrites a/b/x/y/guide AFTER the PortMaster/CFW mapping was loaded, whenever nxinput_has_portmaster_handheld_gap matches the 12-button handheld topology. The rewrite forces a:b1,b:b0,x:b3,y:b2 and guide->rightstick:b9.
why_red: The C1 corpus captured the REAL PortMaster mapping chosen by control.txt/get_controls on the RK3326 GO-Super family: GUID 190000004b4800000011000000010000 with a:b1,b:b0,x:b2,y:b3 (x/y NOT swapped). The rewrite therefore contradicts the sovereign CFW/PortMaster mapping on x/y for any matching topology, and rewriting after load is exactly the pattern the controllers front exists to remove.
resolution: Categories 3 (sovereign mapping) and 5 decide the fix; C2 only makes the divergence observable via NXINPUT-LOAD/NXINPUT-BINDING receipts.
